# Which regexes in your code can hang your server?

> A free static ReDoS scanner for JS, TS and Python with a CI-ready CLI and an optional timing probe. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/regex-redos-check/)
